notes.title: Join the Fizzy Friends Family!
notes.content:
Dear Players

We are thrilled to announce that the Steam page for Fizzy Friends is now live! This multiplayer online physics sandbox game is packed with endless possibilities and will bring you an unprecedented interactive experience.

What Makes Fizzy Friends Special?

Endless possibilities: Utilize advanced physics engines and a rich combination of toys to freely build your dream levels. Create and command: You're not just a player; you're a creator and commander, organizing thrilling gun battles. Multiplayer interaction: Invite your friends to join the battlefield and enjoy a brand new level of interaction together. Cute and fun: We have designed many cute and fun props and characters, immersing players in a sea of joy.

Join Our Discord Community

To better communicate, share, and collaborate, we warmly invite you to join the **Fizzy Friends** Discord community! Here you can: Direct communication with the dev team: Share your valuable feedback and suggestions. Meet new friends: Interact with other players, form teams, and challenge the limits. Get the latest news: Be the first to know about game updates, events, and exclusive content. Click here to join our Discord community!

Add to Wishlist and Follow

Don't forget to add **Fizzy Friends** to your Steam wishlist and click follow! This way, you won't miss any important updates and special offers. Add to Wishlist: Ensure you get the latest content as soon as it's available. Click Follow: Receive the latest news and announcements, staying ahead of the game. Thank you to every player supporting Fizzy Friends. We can't wait to see you create miracles and share joy in the game! Join Fizzy Friends and build your magical world! The Fizzy Friends Development Team
